description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLicenseAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin API. It provides RESTful endpoints for managing employee license records, including CRUD operations such as get, list, create, update, and delete. The class handles request validation, interaction with EmployeeLicenseService, and documentation annotations for API documentation.
